decisions.reason: The bowl capacity and resulting smaller, thinner whisk requirement are already fully represented by the candidate's message-43 INTRODUCE Event, so no additional same-message MODIFY is needed.
The bowl-capacity decision motivates a different whisk size but does not change the existing high-quality mixing or consistent-foam targets.
Changing the specified bowl capacity and whisk size does not alter the requirement to minimize splashing.
The source changes mechanical bowl and whisk specifications, not the required wiring-plan detail or electrical-layout deliverable.
The mechanical bowl-capacity decision does not change the beige primary color or green accent requirements.
Specifying the selected bowls as 4.5 qt does not modify the independently established requirement that bowls be easy to remove and rapidly swapped.
The source does not change the enclosure thickness or maximum-size constraint.
The bowl and whisk sizing decision leaves the DJ-turntable-inspired visual theme unchanged.
The source does not change the requirement that the bottom bowl seal prevent liquid from reaching the electronics.
Although the selected bowl geometry may be reflected in the CAD work, the source does not change the requirement to deliver a system layout.
The source changes bowl and whisk sizing but does not alter the required open/close valve or tap behavior.
The 4.5-qt bowl specification does not change the requirement for a removable or easily flushed spout.
